subject: english
question: Change into passive: Will the committee implement the updated guidelines immediately?

options.text: Will the updated guidelines be implemented immediately by the committee?
Will the updated guidelines being implemented by the committee?
Will the updated guidelines have been implemented by the committee?
Will the updated guidelines implemented by the committee?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Will the committee implement the updated guidelines immediately?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the updated guidelines" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will implement" to "will be implemented" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the committee."
 
• Ensure the word "immediately" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Will the updated guidelines be implemented immediately by the committee?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Will the updated guidelines being implemented by the committee?" – Incorrect structure (missing "be").
 
• **Option 3: **"Will the updated guidelines have been implemented by the committee?" – Incorrect tense (future perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"Will the updated guidelines implemented by the committee?" – Incorrect verb form (missing "be").
